title: Ancient 'as above, so below' symbol on property
summary: Breaks Silence tells of Ancient 'as above, so below' symbol on property, about ancient at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: As above, so below as the Masonic symbol on the property from ancient times seems to denote.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, spoke to podcast host Jesse Michels in an episode about a UFO said to be under the ranch. He says there is a symbol on the property from ancient times, which he links to a Masonic sign, from the secretive fraternal order of Freemasons, meaning 'as above, so below.' He reads it as a hint that what happens in the sky is mirrored by something underground.
